# agent/broad-permissions

Agent settings that skip approvals.

Committed agent settings that grant broad autonomy: Claude Code `defaultMode: "bypassPermissions"`, unscoped `Bash` or `Bash(*)` rules, `enableAllProjectMcpServers: true`; Codex `danger-full-access` with `approval_policy = "never"`; Gemini CLI unscoped `run_shell_command` in `tools.allowed` and `trust: true` MCP servers; Cursor CLI `Shell(*)`.

- Default level: `warn`.
- Looks at: each file in scope, on its own.
- References: [CWE-250](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/250.html), OWASP ASI02, OWASP ASI03.

## Why it matters

Shared settings apply to everyone who opens the project, and a pull request can change them. With approvals off, a prompt injection in a file, issue, or web page can run any command the agent can.

## Flagged

`.claude/settings.json` (warn):

```json
"defaultMode": "bypassPermissions",
```

`.claude/settings.json` (warn):

```json
"Bash",
```

`.claude/settings.json` (warn):

```json
"enableAllProjectMcpServers": true
```

`.codex/config.toml` (warn):

```toml
sandbox_mode = "danger-full-access"
```

`.cursor/cli.json` (warn):

```json
"Shell(*)"
```

`.gemini/settings.json` (warn):

```json
"run_shell_command"
```

`.gemini/settings.json` (warn):

```json
"trust": true
```

## Not flagged

- `"Bash(npm test)",` in `.claude/settings.json`: scoped to one command
- `"allow": ["Bash(*)"]` in `.claude/settings.local.json`: personal settings are not shared with the team
- `sandbox_mode = "workspace-write"` in `.codex/config.toml`: sandboxed, even without approvals
- `sandbox_mode = "danger-full-access"` in `.codex/config.toml`: full access still asks before commands
- `"Shell(git)",` in `.cursor/cli.json`: scoped to git
- `"run_shell_command(git status)",` in `.gemini/settings.json`: scoped to one command
- `"trust": false` in `.gemini/settings.json`: asks before each tool call

## How to fix

Allow specific commands (for example Bash(npm test)) in shared settings and keep broader permissions in your personal settings file.

## If the finding is wrong

Add a comment on the line above, in the comment syntax of the file, that says who decided and why:

```
ubon-ignore agent/broad-permissions: <who decided>: <evidence>
```

Or turn the rule off for the project in `ubon.json`: `"rules": { "agent/broad-permissions": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
